probes.title: Long Sequence, one Cell
probes.oracle: I operations indexed; transfer follows visits; no instruction snapshots or CFG-node growth
probes.kills: full clone or node per Assign

probes.title: Wide declarations
probes.oracle: index proportional to D; resolution work follows R, never I×D

probes.title: Many live facts
probes.dimension: D=N/2N, writes=N/2N in one Sequence and chain of N blocks
probes.oracle: representation-specific bounded update/sharing ledger; compare writes/roots, measured heap and release
probes.kills: full state clone, dense matrix, historical roots or leaked pool

probes.title: Chains, diamonds, cycles and fan-in
probes.dimension: V=1k/2k/10k; E and published changes reported separately
probes.oracle: W1 adjacency visits follow edges; W2 contribution bound Aprop, no global scans; fair convergence
probes.kills: successor scan, redundant propagation/enqueue, lost self-loop

probes.title: Staggered fan-in P1,J,P2,J,...
probes.dimension: N=1k/2k/10k predecessors; constant-size max(rank) state; W3 additionally varies live bindings
probes.oracle: N contributions specifically to J and zero predecessor rereads; auxiliary edges separately counted; coalesced/multi-publication controls
probes.kills: semantically correct predecessor recomputation with ~N² reads

probes.title: Sparse overlapping consumers
probes.oracle: index and same-key analysisRuns unchanged with K; callbacks equal actual matches, phases labelled
probes.kills: per-consumer traversal, I×K broadcast, solver per consumer

probes.title: Dense and duplicate queries
probes.dimension: Q=I/2 then I in same Sequence; duplicate requests over K consumers
probes.oracle: one directional prefix/suffix union per analysis/Entry/Sequence/epoch; selected facts O(Q), not Q×F; stable IN forward or stable OUT backward.
probes.kills: replay per query/site, implicit late replay, full state per query

probes.title: All finite candidates and pool
probes.dimension: N/2N/4N branch literals; include 8/9, 100 and 10000 candidates; overwrites U=N versus U=2
probes.oracle: All supported finite candidates preserved without count-induced remainder; U source-proportional; sharing, convergence and pool release.
probes.kills: candidate truncation, count-induced TOP, nonconvergent domain, global/historical pool

probes.title: Entry contexts and analysis keys
probes.dimension: Entries=1/2/20 with only 1/2 selected; equal/distinct keys/configs
probes.oracle: context buckets preserve activationEntry; demand-only views/runs; no eager Cartesian state
probes.kills: ignore Entry/options, deep-hash cache, duplicate run

probes.title: Text bytes and memory
probes.dimension: B=N/2N with I fixed; short/long IDs, Unicode and long literals
probes.oracle: text processing at boundary once with declared cost; AIR baseline separated

probes.title: Production composition and E2E
probes.dimension: two fresh runs CP4E plus CP3; N/2N dimension not applicable to minimal E2E
probes.oracle: real stages, same defaults, hashes/JARs/pins, memory/file equivalence, PARTIAL preserved
probes.kills: fixture-specific shortcut, golden substituted for stage, result promotes source precision

probes.oracle: Manual node/edge role inventory from AIR fixture and corruptions; supported boundary result admitted, each mutilation rejected.
Manual def X; use X and distinct-anchor use Y; def X; use X witnesses plus independent gen/kill round solver; verify BEFORE/AFTER values and stable OUT reverse suffix replay.
Enumerate finite synthetic executions/states independently of product transfer/join/worklist; every concrete value/point is covered by delivered abstraction; include deliberately wrong transfer.

Stable analysis + controlled failed batch preserves independent structural/analysis-only consumers; only explicit unavailable dependencies block. External delivery receipt verifies intended bytes and destination after writer failure; no self-certifying payload. No resource-induced partial results.

Fixed finite corpus/semantic profile and independent expected outcomes; report refusals, all candidates, open/closed outcomes and controlled phase failures alongside time/memory; no aggregate percent threshold.

probes.title: Size never defines semantic coverage
probes.dimension: N/2N/4N valid inputs of same semantic profile; independently vary nodes/edges/operations/objects/queries/visits/candidates/bytes
probes.oracle: All sizes admitted; convergent analyses STABLE; all finite candidates preserved with unchanged semantic remainder. Infra failure is not a semantic outcome. Core size role contracts and runtime scale oracles both required.
